searchText: Prysm may be DoSed by an unprivileged gossip peer that straggles a current-slot unknown beacon root signed envelope with 2.6 million empty transactions. While prysm decodes and validates this envelope, the attacker queues additional signed envelopes for the current slot putting sufficient memory pressure to take down a 32GB prysm node. Can share more details if needed 🙏 https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5642#discussion_r4056618820 adds some mitigation to this did you try this with my PR in? https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/pull/17433 Yes, that PR is only caps self-built payload path right, this is external builder path, will confirm once I get to run it
